segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the renewal and hear how the first year went for your team.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Happy to. Overall it's been good. The team uses it every day. The main complaint is the export to Excel, it times out on anything over about fifty thousand rows.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: That's a known issue. We have a fix in progress, streaming exports, and it should land by the end of November.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: End of November is fine as long as it actually happens. We hit it every month at quarter close.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Understood. I'll send you a written timeline for that fix this week so your finance lead has something to point to.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Thanks. On the renewal itself, we're at eighty seats now. We'd like to go to one hundred and twenty, but procurement wants a better per-seat price at that volume.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: That's reasonable. At a hundred and twenty seats I can offer fifteen percent off list. Actually, let me correct that, at that tier it's eighteen percent, and that's for a two-year term.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Two years is a harder sell. What would one year look like?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: On a one-year term it would be twelve percent.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Okay. I think procurement will go for the two-year at eighteen if we can add a clause that lets us drop up to ten seats at the first anniversary.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: I can't promise that clause on this call, I need to check with our deal desk. But I don't see why not.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: That's fine. And one more ask, can we get single sign-on included? Right now it's an add-on and security keeps flagging it.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Yes. For a two-year deal at that size, I'm comfortable including SSO at no extra cost.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Great. Then the plan on our side is I'll take the two-year proposal to procurement next Tuesday.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Sounds good. So I'll get you the proposal by Friday: a hundred and twenty seats, two years, eighteen percent off, SSO included, and I'll come back on the seat flexibility clause.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Perfect. Oh, and our renewal date is December fifteenth, so we'd want everything signed by early December.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Noted, early December. Thanks Dana, talk soon.

decisions: Direction: 120 seats, two-year term, 18% off list (not 15%), SSO included at no extra cost
action_items: You: written timeline for the streaming-export fix to Dana this week
You: proposal to Dana by Friday (120 seats, 2 years, 18%, SSO)
You: check seat-flexibility clause (drop up to 10 seats at first anniversary) with deal desk
Dana: take the two-year proposal to procurement next Tuesday
open_questions: Seat flexibility clause pending deal desk
facts: Excel export times out over ~50k rows; fix by end of November
Renewal date Dec 15, sign by early December
